Android decides which assistants are authorized. These calls do not use the MCP server token. The tool switches control access through both MCP and AppFunctions, and Android permissions still apply. Preparing an SMS always leaves it for you to review and send; Direct SMS sends immediately and is only included in the Full build.
Assistant support is currently limited during Android’s experimental preview, so availability depends on your device, assistant, and account.

Phone MCP turns this phone into a server that AI assistants (MCP clients) can connect to. The app has no AI built in — you connect your own, for example Claude Code or Claude Desktop.
1. Enable the tools you want to expose. 2. Start the server with the toggle. 3. Connect your AI client — remotely through phonemcp.ai (works from anywhere), or over the same Wi-Fi network.
The connection guide on the main screen walks you through both.
